Never send a truck to an empty bin again.

Think Lid measures how full every bin really is. ThinkOS turns that into tomorrow's collection run.

  • Routes built from real demand, not fixed rosters
  • Clean reporting for teams and councillors

Know before it overflows.

SensAI watches culverts, drains and catchments with radar. Meridian warns the right crew before an event — not after.

  • Predictive flood alerts from live and weather data

ANY AUSTRALIAN CITY
